title.narrative: TOGETHER, ADVOCATE FOR EMPOWERED COMMUNITIES TO ELIMINATE THE ABUSE OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN IN SOUTH KORDOFAN STATES OF SUDAN.

description.narrative: ltpgtRegion one (R1) is in the scenario of no-peace-no-war. Inter and intra-region dynamics do not indicate active conflict between SPLM- EL HILU and the Sudan Army (SAF) and Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Crossline analyses (Conflict sensitivity facility-Sudan, 2024) may shift significantly if SAF settles in the north, allowing RSF to control Darfur, West and North Kordofan, White Nile, Blue Nile, and Gedaref.nbsp R1 has a population of about 1.3M in the central areas and 0.75M in Western Jebel. 46% (1M) of the R1 population are in IPC 3, 12% (0.2M) in IPC4, and 2% (48k) in IPC5 (FSMU, 2024). The population is highly traumatised from protracted war and violent conflict, with over 1M host households having immediate needs for integrated and triple-nexus-based water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), gender-based violence (GBV), and economic development and food security (EDFS) programming. Additionally, R1 has welcomed over 788,137 internally displaced persons (IDPs) and returnees since the RSF-SAF war started in April 2023 (Local Authority Surveillance Reports (SRRA), 2024), compounding the number of vulnerable households, both hosts, IDPs, and returnees that have experienced grave rights violations and are psycho-socially stressed with deficits in life-saving services including resilient EDFSnbspopportunities, and WASH, HEALTH, NUTRITION, Education and protection services (GBV+ Child Protection (CP) services). ltbrgtThe proposed SHF andnbspNorwegian Church Aid (NCA) project will be informed by co-design and co-creation modalities during the formative, delivery, and summative phases of its management, and will use inter-faith actors and local civil society organisationnbspand grassroots groups to respond to the needs of the vulnerable households and communities.ltbrgtThe core focus will be on emboldening local capacities and improving the quality of services across nexus-based GBV programming, with integration of WASH, EDFS and social cohesion interventions, given that NCA already has pre-positioned WASH supplies in the region and has ongoing EDFS activities in the region that will be complemented by the proposed project.ltbrgtThe project has the below targets and activities:ltbrgtlt/pgtltolgtltligtReach 32,040nbspwomen, girls, and community members with positive messaging on services and service points for conflict, gender, and environmentally responsive GBV and WASH, with integrations of EDFS opportunities.lt/ligtltligtReach 9,600nbspvulnerable people with conflict, gender, and environmentally responsive GBV and WASH services.lt/ligtltligtSupport 4500nbspvulnerable households with conflict, gender, and environmentally responsive EDFS startup capital and targeted training on crop diversification, agricultural diversification, market systems, and value chains.lt/ligtltligtIncrease the number of active and competent community action and support (CBPNs and social cohesion/peace) structures to 60 units.lt/ligtltligtTrain and resource 100 NCA and partner personnel on GBV, WASH, EDFS, and social cohesion.lt/ligtltligtEnhance monitoring and surveillance capacities of NCA and partner staff on thematic integrations and nexus needs.lt/ligtltligtTrain and resource NCA staff and partners on project cycle management (PCM), grants management, and the critical concepts of co-design and co-creation in service delivery.lt/ligtlt/olgtltpgtSuccess for the project will be measured in four stages:lt/pgtltolgtltligtCivil Society level: Strengthen faith-based actors and local CSOs’ ability to prevent SGBV, VAW, and VAC effectively.lt/ligtltligtInstitutional level: Improve the capacity of service providers in terms of the quality of the assistance and referrals among services for women and girls.lt/ligtltligtCommunity level: Facilitate a community-led process to identify and tackle gender-discriminatory social norms, attitudes, and practices that justify Violence against women and girls (VAWG).lt/ligtltligtIndividual level: Empower women, men, and young girls/boys to proactively promote gender equality, climate resilience, and socially cohesive behaviours.lt/ligtlt/olgtltpgtltbrgtlt/pgt
